title: Metal: The Moving Fortress

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: This daisy is protected by five layers of politeness.
directions: [board: Clank sets a daisy in a thick pot beside the table. No piece moves.]
[card: METAL DEPARTMENT. The element chart never changes defense.]
[card: ROSTER KEY. Hit = base attack before elements. Shield = full defense. Walk = squares per action. Take = maximum crystals at own turn end, limited by reserve. Keep beside every roster recital.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: My helmet would like five layers.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Politeness is not armor. Helmet defense: zero.

lines.speaker: EMBER
lines.text: Memo. We stamped one fortress PARTIALLY BROWNED. That closed our kitchen for the turn.
directions: [board: Clank pins a work order to the wall: HOLD THE LINE. EARN ON THE SQUARE.]

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: I have met that Hono. It left a mark. The fortress was still standing.
lines.performanceNote: Articulate every word and every sentence in the supplied text. Do not drop the final sentence. Hono is pronounced hoh-noh as a normal two-syllable name, never as letters. Keep the small final phrases fully audible.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Sparks burn the Garden Wall. The Hono's attack three becomes four against Metal.
directions: [board: the Hono card beside a fresh Tanka. The Tanka's damage marker reads zero.]
lines.performanceNote: Articulate every word and every sentence in the supplied text. Do not drop the final sentence. Hono is pronounced hoh-noh as a normal two-syllable name, never as letters. Keep the small final phrases fully audible.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The chart never changes defense. The Tanka's defense is five.
directions: [board: the Tanka's card lights. Defense five. The six does not move.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Four in. One lit. The fortress lived, so that Hono is done attacking.
directions: [sfx: bonk, dull] [board: four of the five shield pips go dark. One stays lit. The Hono's attack marker greys out.]
lines.performanceNote: Articulate every word and every sentence in the supplied text. Do not drop the final sentence. Hono is pronounced hoh-noh as a normal two-syllable name, never as letters. Keep the small final phrases fully audible.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: Strong is useful. Invincible is a different word.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: If the Tanka survives and pays its bill, it heals at its own turn start.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: Job two. The fortress is standing on three crystals. Its Mining is four.
directions: [board: separate income trial. A White Tanka ends its turn on a square holding three crystals. This is a new position, not the attacked defender taking an immediate turn.] [card: the Tanka, Mining four] [card: this square, three crystals]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Mining is the most a piece can collect at its turn end.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Mining four. Three crystals in the square. The turn is ending.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: How many crystals does my fortress collect?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Nothing here is timed. Count it, or watch the square with us.
lines.question: How many crystals does my fortress collect?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Three. The square ran out before the bucket did.
directions: [sfx: crystal clink] [board: three crystals slide to the bank. The square turns grey and reads zero.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Bucket or puddle. The puddle was three.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Next payday here is an Empty Payday. Large pot. Empty square.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Tier three. That fortress owes two crystals when its turn starts.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: Three in, two out next morning.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: This is the Inyan. Shield of three. Collects up to two crystals a turn. Walks one. That is the Inyan.
directions: [card: EVIDENCE. Proves: one Hono leaves a fresh Tanka on one; a Tanka on three crystals collects three. Not checked: what the rest of White could do this turn.]
[card: METAL. The Inyan. The Mazask. The Tanka.]

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: This is the Mazask. Shield of four. Collects up to three crystals a turn. Walks one. That is the Mazask.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: This is the Tanka. Shield of five. Collects up to four crystals a turn. Walks two. That is the Tanka.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: I am excellent at standing somewhere with purpose. Without purpose, it is mostly loitering.
directions: [card: the trouble: four squares away · the Inyan walks one square an action]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Distance to the trouble: four squares. Speed one.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: I can reach the danger, or I can reach it in time. Today those are different squares.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: The daisy would like to speak to the Toast Department.
directions: [card: WORK CARD. METAL. Shields three, four, five. Collects two, three, four. Only the Tanka walks two.]

[card: MISSION. ONE ACTION LEFT. Inyan on C three. Goal one: empty C four. Goal two: empty C five. Separate starting positions, clear path, no attack required. Which goal fits before turn end? Speed one means one square per action.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the bonk matrix for metal. We check all eighteen enemy unit types, including matching types. Both pieces start at full health and are already next to each other. One attack, not a whole turn.

supplement.title: Read one tier at a time
supplement.body:
Green: this unit one-shots the enemy.
Red: that enemy one-shots this unit.
Both at full health · adjacent · one legal attack.
This is damage, not a movement or safety prediction.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tier one: the Inyan. Attack one, defense three, speed one, and Mining two. Look at the green side first.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: With one attack, the Inyan can finish Sjor, Göl, Gölge and Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the red side. A full health Inyan is one shot by Hi, Hono, Kagari, Umeme, Kimubunga and Karanlık. Every unlit attacker needs help or earlier damage.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is the tier one card. Pause here to compare any names. The same enemy can appear on both sides: whoever attacks first may finish the other.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tier two: the Mazask. Attack two, defense four, speed one, and Mining three. Look at the green side first.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: With one attack, the Mazask can finish Hi, Hono, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Straumr, Göl, Gölge and Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the red side. A full health Mazask is one shot by Hono, Kagari and Kimubunga. Every unlit attacker needs help or earlier damage.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is the tier two card. Pause here to compare any names. The same enemy can appear on both sides: whoever attacks first may finish the other.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tier three: the Tanka. Attack two, defense five, speed two, and Mining four. Look at the green side first.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: With one attack, the Tanka can finish Hi, Hono, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Straumr, Göl, Gölge and Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the red side. A full health Tanka is one shot by Kagari. Every unlit attacker needs help or earlier damage.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is the tier three card. Pause here to compare any names. The same enemy can appear on both sides: whoever attacks first may finish the other.

lines.speaker: CLANK
lines.text: Strong is useful. Invincible is a different word.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Today was plenty. You have met all six elements and learned the game rules. Try a practice game, and keep the bonk cards nearby.
